# selector locator

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:selectorLocator`](gmeow-selectorLocator.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/selectorLocator>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A generic locator string within a cited work (e.g. 'section 3.2', 'image 4', 'entry 17'), expressed as a literal within a selector.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:selectorLocator`](gmeow-selectorLocator.md) from [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record a structural or domain locator a [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) pinpoints when neither a page nor a character offset fits — a section, figure, image, table, or register entry.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it where a page ([`gmeow:selectorPage`](gmeow-selectorPage.md)) or character offset ([`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md)) is the natural anchor, and avoid overloading it to smuggle a verbatim quote — use [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:selectorLocator`](gmeow-selectorLocator.md) on a [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) to the structural locator string; combine with [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md) when the passage must also be verifiable.

### Examples

- ex:loc [`gmeow:selectorLocator`](gmeow-selectorLocator.md) "entry 17".
